title: One entry of the root DataSet list

then.description: In-memory entries declare an empty table; a path would have nothing to point at.

path.description: Resolved relative to the config file. A list concatenates sources.

type.description: File-backed (csv / hdf5 / parquet) or in-memory. `pd.DataFrame` declares an empty table and `pd.Series` an empty single-column table; both take no `path` and are filled by transforms via `to_df` / `to_ds`.

dataset.description: HDF5 group name. Ignored for csv / parquet.

rename.description: HDF5 source-name aliases, applied at load time.

source.description: Full HDF5 dataset path in the file.

target.description: Short alias that expressions and coordinates use instead.

transform.description: Dataset-level pre-steps, applied before any layer sees the table.

columnmap.description: Legacy HDF5 column renaming; `jplot --parse-data` strips it.

x-jarvis-example:
- name: df
  path: ./samples.hdf5
  type: hdf5
  dataset: data
- name: env
  type: pd.DataFrame
